## Supplementary public read and limitations

- Independently read [official C overview](https://duckdb.org/docs/2.0/clients/c/overview), 2026-11-01 UTC, warning/header paragraphs. The latest release-page content is not a selected-pin source identity or stability promise. No installation/configuration instructions were acted on.
- No new immutable source fetch, public index, private tree or failed-request retry was necessary. A's unavailable raw headers/YAML pages and known missing paths remain unavailable/stopped in this peer; no absence conclusion follows.
- All 41 acquisition metadata records were reconciled, but immediate-index listings were not turned into an API-wide negative proof. A's complete named-spec search is explicitly a bounded author-search report; this peer's independent actual-body inspection is the focused surface above.
- Review does not supply an independent generated-header, entire-engine cleanup, primary-paper empirical-study or planner-order audit. It does not certify unreported empirical activities as having occurred or not occurred; no empirical result is accepted from source metadata.
